{"draft": "Wynn Resorts Q2 2026 recap
Results:
- Revenue: $1.86 billion, rose from $1.74 billion a year earlier
- Net income attributable to Wynn Resorts, Limited: $140.1 million, climbed from $66.2 million a year earlier
- Diluted net income per share: $1.32, grew from $0.64 a year earlier
- Adjusted net income attributable to Wynn Resorts, Limited: $127.5 million, or $1.24 per diluted share
- Adjusted Property EBITDAR: $568.3 million, up from $552.4 million a year earlier
Segments:
- Wynn Palace revenue: $653.4 million, jumped from $539.6 million a year earlier; Adjusted Property EBITDAR: $201.5 million, rose from $157.2 million
- Wynn Macau revenue: $351.1 million; Adjusted Property EBITDAR: $95.5 million
- Las Vegas Operations revenue: $643.2 million; Adjusted Property EBITDAR: $215.2 million
- Encore Boston Harbor revenue: $209.3 million; Adjusted Property EBITDAR: $56.1 million
Cash and capital:
- Cash and cash equivalents as of June 30, 2026: $1.57 billion
- Total current and long-term debt outstanding at June 30, 2026: $10.72 billion
- Share repurchases during the quarter: $75.0 million in aggregate cost
- Declared cash dividend: $0.25 per share
Outlook:
- Cash contributed to Wynn Al Marjan Island joint venture during the quarter: $48.1 million, bringing life-to-date contributions to $1.06 billion
- Wynn Al Marjan Island opening: currently expected in September 2027"}
